## Active profiles

- [Python Backend](profiles/python-backend.md) (`runtime/python-backend` 0.1.0) - Framework-agnostic Python backend services - conventions, service boundaries, errors, async, and testing.
- [FastAPI](profiles/fastapi.md) (`runtime/fastapi` 0.1.0) - FastAPI-specific HTTP layer conventions on top of the python-backend profile.
- [Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)](profiles/rag.md) (`ai/rag` 0.1.0) - Retrieval-augmented generation - retrieval, grounding, context assembly, source attribution, and retrieval evaluation. Vendor-neutral.

## Workflows

- [implementation](workflows/implementation.md) - Use for any non-trivial change - features, bug fixes, refactors - to plan, implement, test, and verify in small steps.
- [code-review](workflows/code-review.md) - Use to review a diff or pull request against the project's standards and active profiles before it is merged.
- [retrieval-evaluation](workflows/retrieval-evaluation.md) - Use when changing chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, ranking, or prompts that consume retrieved context, to measure the impact before merging.
